stories.summary: Mamdani’s plan was written to show that he takes antisemitism seriously. His October 7 statement showed it was written to give him cover for the hatred he keeps feeding.

stories.headline: On October 7, Hamas’s goal was not the Nova festival - it was New York - opinion
stories.summary: Sinwar’s goal was to initiate a future multifront war that could succeed after Israel lost the world’s support, and ideally after Iran obtained a nuclear capability.

stories.headline: Unproven genocide claims are used as weapons to fuel antisemitism, isolate Israel - opinion
stories.summary: The charge of genocide against Israel has become a powerful tool for its critics, with consequences reaching far beyond the Gaza war.

stories.headline: Pentagon updates official count of US service members killed during Iran war - report
stories.summary: The Washington Post reported in September that the previous official count of 18 may have been inaccurate and that at least four service members were potentially excluded from the official tally.

stories.headline: Putin Downplayed Immediate Ukraine Talks Resumption in Phone Call With Trump, Kremlin Says
stories.summary: The Kremlin also said Putin and Trump discussed major economic initiatives during the phone call, including potential supplies of Russian fuel.

stories.headline: Rosatom Says it Wins Tribunal Ruling in Finnish Nuclear Plant Dispute
stories.summary: Rosatom said the International Chamber of Commerce agreed that a Finnish firm wrongly terminated the contract for a new nuclear power plant.

stories.headline: Germany Sticks to Russia Sanctions After Trump Diesel Announcement
stories.summary: Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to the global market to ease fuel prices. Kyiv's allies are not supportive.

stories.headline: Russian Attack on Ukrainian City Kills 20, a Day After Trump Eases Diesel Sanctions on Moscow
stories.summary: The Ukrainian President offered some of his sharpest criticism of Donald Trump after this week's third mass-casualty Russian attack.
